title: Labor market impacts of AI: A new measure and early evidence
finding: Primary read. Massenkoff and McCrory. Observed exposure counts tasks with significant work-related Claude use, with full weight for automated and half weight for augmentative use, averaged to occupation by time share. No systematic rise in unemployment for highly exposed workers since late 2022 (DiD near zero). Young (22-25) job-finding into the most-exposed occupations fell ~14% vs 2022 (barely significant); no such drop for workers over 25. ~30% of workers have zero coverage. A 10-pp increase in coverage is associated with 0.6-pp lower BLS 2024-34 projected growth.

title: Earth System Digital Twins (ESDT) program
finding: ESDT is not a stand-alone ESTO program. In 2024 ESTO created the Advanced Modeling Technology (AMT) program, split out of AIST, whose aim is to build frameworks for Earth System Digital Twins. ESDT is the capability goal within AMT, and 13 AMT projects were selected under ROSES-23 AIST (A.58).

title: Destination Earth (DestinE)
finding: DestinE moved into its third phase (announced Jun 30, 2026), which runs to June 2028 after two completed phases. It is implemented by ECMWF, EUMETSAT and ESA under the European Commission (DG CONNECT). The climate-adaptation and weather-extremes digital twins and the Digital Twin Engine were operationalised in phase 2 and are operated and evolved in phase 3.
